card.name: Frequency words in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: The frequency word in a dosing schedule, such as twice, times or day in phrases like "divided into twice daily doses" or "three times a day". It fires just before the schedule phrase is completed.

modes.label: Twice or times before daily
modes.description: Frequency word after a number or 'into' that is followed by 'daily' or 'a day'.
modes.example: (given as a single daily dose or divided into<< twice>> daily doses)

modes.label: Day or daily ending the phrase
modes.description: The closing word of a 'twice a day' or 'twice daily' schedule.
